content.unEditedContent:
Senior Finance Business Partner Our Client – Leading WA Mining Operation

Hybrid Perth / DIDO from Perth. Roster 5/2, 4/3

Assignment duration: 3-6 month with view to permanent

Our Client is searching for a sharp, influential Senior Finance Business Partner to support a major mining site with high‑quality insights, tight cost control, and strong business partnering. If you love being close to operations and turning numbers into action, this role puts you right where the decisions are made.

What You’ll Do
  • Budgeting & Forecasting — Lead annual budgets and rolling forecasts

  • Month-End Reporting — Deliver accurate cost & capex reporting with clear variance insights

  • Business Partnering — Support and challenge operational leaders with data‑driven advice

  • Process Improvement — Lift reporting standards and streamline workflows

  • Capex Oversight — Support capital pipeline and governance

  • Operational Forecasting — Produce weekly physicals forecasts

  • SOX Compliance — Maintain strong internal controls

  • Financial Modelling — Build models in Excel, SAP BPC & support cost driver analysis

  • Cost Culture — Develop KPIs and reporting with site leaders

  • Leadership Presentations — Present monthly cost review insights

What You Bring
  • 3–5 years’ mining industry experience (site exposure ideal)

  • Degree in Accounting/Finance + CPA / CA / CMA

  • Strong management accounting background

  • Advanced Excel (modelling, analytics)

  • SAP + BPC experience (essential)

  • Xeras experience (highly regarded)

  • Strong stakeholder engagement — confident, collaborative, influential

  • Ability to simplify complex data and communicate clearly

  • A proactive mindset — you speak up, solve problems, and drive improvement

Nice to Have
  • Power BI

  • Additional mining systems exposure

  • Experience improving reporting processes or building new tools

Why This Role Stands Out
  • High visibility across site leadership

  • Real influence on operational and financial outcomes

  • Fast‑paced, hands‑on environment

  • Opportunity to shape cost culture and reporting standards

  • Work with a respected mining operator through Our Client

At Chandler Macleod, we are committed to fostering a diverse workforce where everyone is welcome. We encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, women, neurodiverse, people living with a disability and the LGBTIQA+ community.

You can read more about our commitment to diversity and inclusion at https://www.chandlermacleod.com/diversity-and-inclusion.

Are you ready to be an important part of this ever-transformational journey?

At HCLTech Australia, we value the unique perspective and contributions of all individual and we actively encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people to apply for this role.

Job Title: Data Integration Engineer – Level 3

Role Overview:

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Integration Engineer (Level 3) to design, build, and manage enterprise-scale data integration solutions on Azure. This role requires strong expertise in cloud-native data services, integration patterns, DevOps practices, and L3 production support to ensure reliability, performance, and scalability of data platforms.

Key Responsibilities

· Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end data integration solutions across enterprise systems.

· Build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and Azure Data Flows.

· Develop high-performance data processing solutions using Azure Databricks (ADB) and Python.

· Implement event-driven architectures using Azure Service Bus.

· Develop and manage serverless applications using Azure Functions.

· Design and expose APIs using Azure API Management (APIM).

· Build and maintain NoSQL data solutions using Cosmos DB.

· Manage secure access to secrets and credentials using Azure Key Vault.

· Monitor and troubleshoot applications using:

o Azure Application Insights

o Log Analytics Workspace

· Deploy and manage containerized applications using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

· Implement CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitOps practices via ArgoCD.

· Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform.

· Ensure effective use of Azure services for integration (eventing, messaging, API, compute).

· Provide Level 3 (L3) operational support, including:

o Incident management and resolution

o Root cause analysis (RCA)

o Performance optimization and system tuning

· Collaborate with architects, data engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver robust solutions.

· Implement best practices for security, monitoring, governance, and reliability.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

· Strong experience in Data Integration / Data Engineering.

· Hands-on expertise in:

o Azure Data Factory (ADF)

o Azure Data Flows

o Azure Databricks (ADB)

o Python programming

· Experience with:

o Azure Functions

o Azure Service Bus

o Azure API Management (APIM)

o Cosmos DB

· Monitoring and observability tools:

o Azure Application Insights

o Log Analytics Workspace

· Security:

o Azure Key Vault

· Containerization and orchestration:

o Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

· DevOps & deployment:

o Azure DevOps

o ArgoCD

· Infrastructure as Code:

o Terraform

· Strong understanding of Azure services related to integration (messaging, APIs, serverless, data pipelines).

· Experience in performance tuning and cost optimization on Azure.

· Exposure to API-led and microservices-based architectures.

· Proven operations/support (L3) experience in production environments.

· Good understanding of:

o Distributed systems

o Data modelling & data warehousing

o Cloud architecture and scalability patterns

Good-to-Have Skills

· Experience with legacy or enterprise ETL tools:

o IBM DataStage

· Advanced monitoring/observability tools:

o Datadog

o Splunk

· Knowledge of hybrid integration patterns.

Qualifications

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.

· Total integration experience of 12+ years with 6 to 8+ years of relevant experience in data integration, data engineering, or related roles.

· Azure certifications (preferred):

o Azure Data Engineer Associate

o Azure DevOps Engineer Expert

Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities across the globe, we pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees regardless of race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, physical disability or genetic information, military or veteran status, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state, and/or local law.

Candidate Data Privacy Notice | HCL Technologies

We are committed to respecting your privacy and for the protection of your personal data. Your personal data will be collected and processed in line with our candidate privacy notice: https://www.hcltech.com/candidate-privacy-notice. This privacy notice will help you to understand what personal data we collect about you, how we use this personal data, and what rights you have regarding your personal data. By replying to this email or submitting any personal data to HCL Tech, you acknowledge that you have read and understood the candidate privacy notice and have provided your consent to the processing of your data for recruitment purposes as described in the privacy notice”.

Senior SQL Database Administrator (Azure SQL Managed Instance)Join a major enterprise transformation
We are seeking an experienced Senior SQL Database Administrator to play a key role in a large-scale cloud transformation project. This position will focus on migrating critical database workloads to Azure SQL Managed Instance, optimising cloud-hosted database environments, and implementing modern database deployment practices using CI/CD and source control.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced DBA who enjoys working across both project delivery and operational support within a complex enterprise environment.
What you'll be doing
  • Lead and support the migration of Microsoft SQL Server databases to Azure SQL Managed Instance.
  • Optimise and stabilise cloud-hosted database environments following migration.
  • Design, implement and maintain database deployment pipelines using CI/CD and source control practices, including YAML-based pipelines.
  • Deliver business-as-usual database administration to ensure high availability, reliability and performance.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot and tune SQL Server and Azure SQL databases.
  • Manage database schema changes and deployments across development, testing and production environments.
  • Implement and maintain backup, recovery, disaster recovery and business continuity solutions.
  • Support database security, governance and operational best practices.
  • Work closely with project teams, developers and technical stakeholders to deliver high-quality database solutions.
About You
You'll be an experienced SQL Database Administrator with a strong background supporting enterprise Microsoft environments and cloud-based database platforms.
You'll bring:
  • Extensive experience administering Microsoft SQL Server in enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure SQL Managed Instance migrations and ongoing support.
  • Strong knowledge of database performance tuning, monitoring, backup and recovery.
  • Experience implementing database CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Git and YAML deployment pipelines.
  • Experience managing database releases across multiple environments.
  • Strong understanding of database security and governance.
  • Advanced T-SQL development, scripting and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience supporting production-critical systems within complex enterprise environments.
  • Experience with Microsoft Business Intelligence technologies including:
    • SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)
    • SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS)
    • SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)
  • Experience with High Availability and Disaster Recovery technologies including SQL Server Clustering and Log Shipping across both on-premises and Azure environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to provide technical advice on database architecture, optimisation, security and recovery.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
Desirable Experience
  • Azure DevOps
  • Git source control
  • Cloud migration projects
  • Enterprise application support
  • Business continuity and disaster recovery planning
Why Apply?
  • Work on a significant enterprise cloud transformation.
  • Exposure to modern Azure database technologies and DevOps practices.
  • Collaborative, high-performing technical team.
  • Opportunity to make a genuine impact on critical enterprise systems.
If you're an experienced SQL DBA with strong Azure expertise and enjoy working across both project delivery and operational support, we'd love to hear from you.

content.jobHook: We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Business Analyst with deep expertise in Governance, Risk, and Compliance.
content.unEditedContent:
We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Business Analyst with deep expertise in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) to join our Fed Gov's Cyber Program for a fast-paced, 3-month engagement.

You will bridge the gap between complex technical security requirements and business objectives. Be instrumental in analysing processes, identifying risks, and ensuring our program aligns with federal compliance frameworks and institutional risk appetites.

An active Negative Vetting Level 1 clearance is mandatory for this role. Applications without this cannot be considered due to the urgency of the engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead workshops and engage with diverse stakeholders to elicit, analyse, and document business and technical requirements for the Cyber Program.
  • Evaluate current state processes against cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., Essential Eight, ISM, PSPF) and identify compliance gaps.
  • Conduct risk assessments, threat modeling support, and business impact analyses to inform project priorities.
  • Develop high-quality business cases, process maps, user stories, and traceability matrices.
  • Translate complex cyber concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical business leaders and vice versa.

What We Are Looking For

  • Proven track record as a Business Analyst specifically within Cybersecurity or GRC programs.
  • Strong familiarity with Australian Government security frameworks (ISM, PSPF, Essential Eight) and/or international standards (ISO 27001, NIST).
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for managing stakeholders in a complex, environment.
  • Ability to hit the ground running, digest complex environments quickly, and deliver high-quality outputs within a tight 3-month timeframe.

content.unEditedContent:
Please note this role is fully remote and please only submit English resume or CV.

Operations Analyst, Stake Super (Sao Paulo - Brazil)
About Stake

We’re an Australian investing platform that helps ambitious people confidently grow their wealth. By offering seamless, immersive access to ASX and Wall St, we’ve empowered a new wave of investors. Today, we have 750,000+ customers and more than A$8B under administration. Join us as we continue to reshape the financial industry, inspire investor confidence and unleash the investor in everyone.

About the role

We are looking for an Operations Analyst to join our Operations team in Brazil.

Our Operations team sits at the heart of the customer experience. It's the team that keeps our products moving with speed, precision and care, ensuring every customer interaction is accurate, compliant and effortless. As Stake continues to grow, Operations plays a critical role in scaling our systems, improving our processes and helping us deliver an investing experience people genuinely love.

You'll work across the full operational lifecycle of Stake Super, partnering closely with Customer Success, Product, Finance and Compliance to solve problems, improve workflows and uncover opportunities to make things simpler. You'll combine operational excellence with curiosity, using data and AI-powered tools to help us continually raise the bar for quality and efficiency.

What success looks like

Success in this role is about creating an operation that scales as quickly as our ambitions. You'll help build the systems, processes and ways of working that allow customers to move through their investing journey with confidence.

  • Own critical operational processes across Stake Super, delivering consistently accurate, timely and compliant outcomes.
  • Solve customer and operational challenges with urgency, partnering across teams to deliver seamless experiences.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows and introduce automation, AI and agentic solutions that unlock meaningful efficiency.
  • Use SQL and operational data to surface insights, identify trends and influence better business decisions.
  • Continuously improve operational documentation, controls and reporting to support a growing business.
  • Proactively identify risks before they become issues, helping strengthen operational resilience and compliance.
  • Become a trusted operational partner across Customer Success, Product, Finance and Compliance.
  • Raise the standard for how the team works by contributing ideas, improving processes and helping build a culture of continuous improvement.
You'll thrive here if…
  • You have experience in operations, financial services or another detail-oriented environment where quality and ownership matter.
  • You enjoy solving ambiguous problems and naturally look for ways to simplify, automate and improve how work gets done.
  • You're confident working with data and SQL, using insights to inform decisions rather than relying on assumptions.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate well across technical and non-technical teams.
  • You're comfortable using AI tools and large language models to increase productivity and redesign operational workflows.
  • You thrive in a fast-moving environment where ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement are valued every day.
Bonus if you've ever
  • Worked with superannuation or SMSF administration.
  • Used BigQuery or similar analytics platforms.
  • Built automated workflows using AI agents or low-code automation tools.
  • Supported operational processes within a fintech or regulated financial services business.
Benefits of working at Stake

You’ll have the opportunity to work with autonomy while learning from some of the best talent in the industry, playing a meaningful role in building a company that has loads of positive momentum and excitement around it. Having said that, we also have perks. Please see on our Careers website the list of benefits under our Grow with Stake program.

  • Professional development allowance
  • Health insurance
  • Parental leave
  • Wellbeing support
  • Annual leave swap days and mental health days
  • Team days and talent referral bonus
So what happens next?

Once we've received your application, we'll give it the attention it deserves and if we think you’d be a good addition to our team, we’ll give you a call and from there, you'll cruise through our recruitment process.

To all recruitment agencies: Stake does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias or directly to Stake employees. Stake is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

We’re an Australian investing platform that helps ambitious people confidently grow their wealth. By offering seamless, immersive access to ASX and Wall St, we’ve empowered a new wave of investors. Today, we have 750,000+ customers and more than A$8B under administration. Join us as we continue to reshape the financial industry, inspire investor confidence and unleash the investor in everyone.
About the role
We are looking for an
Operations Analyst
to join our
Operations
team in
Brazil

Our Operations team sits at the heart of the customer experience. It's the team that keeps our products moving with speed, precision and care, ensuring every customer interaction is accurate, compliant and effortless. As Stake continues to grow, Operations plays a critical role in scaling our systems, improving our processes and helping us deliver an investing experience people genuinely love.

You'll work across the full operational lifecycle of Stake Super, partnering closely with Customer Success, Product, Finance and Compliance to solve problems, improve workflows and uncover opportunities to make things simpler. You'll combine operational excellence with curiosity, using data and AI-powered tools to help us continually raise the bar for quality and efficiency.
What success looks like

Success in this role is about creating an operation that scales as quickly as our ambitions. You'll help build the systems, processes and ways of working that allow customers to move through their investing journey with confidence.
Own critical operational processes across Stake Super, delivering consistently accurate, timely and compliant outcomes.
Solve customer and operational challenges with urgency, partnering across teams to deliver seamless experiences.
Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows and introduce automation, AI and agentic solutions that unlock meaningful efficiency.
Use SQL and operational data to surface insights, identify trends and influence better business decisions.
Continuously improve operational documentation, controls and reporting to support a growing business.
Proactively identify risks before they become issues, helping strengthen operational resilience and compliance.
Become a trusted operational partner across Customer Success, Product, Finance and Compliance.
Raise the standard for how the team works by contributing ideas, improving processes and helping build a culture of continuous improvement.
You'll thrive here if…
You have experience in operations, financial services or another detail-oriented environment where quality and ownership matter.
You enjoy solving ambiguous problems and naturally look for ways to simplify, automate and improve how work gets done.
You're confident working with data and SQL, using insights to inform decisions rather than relying on assumptions.
You communicate clearly and collaborate well across technical and non-technical teams.
You're comfortable using AI tools and large language models to increase productivity and redesign operational workflows.
You thrive in a fast-moving environment where ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement are valued every day.
Bonus if you've ever
Worked with superannuation or SMSF administration.
Used BigQuery or similar analytics platforms.
Built automated workflows using AI agents or low-code automation tools.
Supported operational processes within a fintech or regulated financial services business.
Benefits of working at Stake

You’ll have the opportunity to work with autonomy while learning from some of the best talent in the industry, playing a meaningful role in building a company that has loads of positive momentum and excitement around it. Having said that, we also have perks. Please see on our Careers website the list of benefits under our
Grow with Stake
program.
Professional development allowance
Health insurance
Parental leave
Wellbeing support
Annual leave swap days and mental health days
Team days and talent referral bonus
So what happens next?

Once we've received your application, we'll give it the attention it deserves and if we think you’d be a good addition to our team, we’ll give you a call and from there, you'll cruise through our recruitment process.

To all recruitment agencies: Stake does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias or directly to Stake employees. Stake is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

content.jobHook: Anduril is seeking an Aerodynamicist to join the Omen team at either our Costa Mesa HQ, or Melbourne, Australia office. Omen is Anduril’s...
content.unEditedContent:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is seeking an Aerodynamicist to join the Omen team at either our Costa Mesa HQ, or Melbourne, Australia office. Omen is Anduril’s hover-to-cruise autonomous air vehicle (AAV) that packs the endurance, payload, and mission flexibility of much larger airplanes into a novel runway-independent Group 3 platform. Omen can operate from ship decks, beaches, or remote island clearings, providing true runway independence and freedom of maneuver across defense and civilian domains. Omen is the first tail-sitter aircraft with a mass-production contract, with an order of 50 systems representing a decisive investment that anchors production and accelerates the development of future systems.

You will work on new aircraft development in a lean, high-ownership culture where you directly shape the product and operate at a velocity to fly new designs within months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Aerodynamicist on the Maneuver Dominance Team, you will be designing unmanned vehicles intended to revolutionize the aerospace field. You will be engaged in the full development lifecycle. You possess strong programming and analytical skills with a focus on aerodynamic design, analysis, and testing. Competitive compensation and top-tier benefits are provided, along with a commitment to innovation in military technology..

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Aerodynamic design of unmanned air vehicles/missiles at conceptual, preliminary, and detail design maturities
  • Aerodynamic analysis of unmanned air vehicles, using both low and high order methods, including analysis tool development and improvement as needed
  • Stability and control analysis
  • Aircraft performance modeling and simulation
  • Aerodynamic loads generation
  • Wind tunnel test planning, execution, and analysis
  • Flight test planning, execution, and analysis
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • High-ownership and a bias toward action – if you see a problem, you want to fix it
  • Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineer, Robotics, Physics, or related technical discipline
  • 8-10+ years of work experience as an individual contributing engineer in a high-impact, start-up environment
  • Experience with aircraft performance, analysis predictions, and Stability & Control.
  • Competent in a variety of aerodynamic analysis techniques including hand calculations, vortex, lattice methods, panel methods, and computational fluid dynamics (CFD)
  • Wind tunnel and flight test experience including data acquisition, data analysis and project coordination
  • Strong programming skills in higher-level languages (e.g., MATLAB, Python) for internal tool development in a version-controlled environment
  • Experience preparing formal documentation (i.e., specifications, test procedures, technical reports, etc.)
  • Experience in engineering team leadership and project execution for aerospace, automotive, or defense sectors with focus on electric or hybrid propulsion
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance (US applicant) or NV-1 AUS security clearance (AUS applicant)
  • Travel to test sites and vendors as needed
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • StarCCM+ and/or Flow360 experience
  • Experience with subsonic, transonic and supersonic flow regimes
  • Active U.S. Secret security clearance (US applicant), or active NV-1 security clearance (AUS applicant)

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 
Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit . 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

content.jobHook: Senior HR Advisor Analytics including workforce planning, analysing trends, managing risks, and implementing strategies.
content.unEditedContent:
The Role

This position undertakes work that is complex to highly-complex in nature and works with independence subject to limited direction against CASA's established priorities, practices, and methodologies, to deliver quality outcomes aligned to CASA's strategic operational priorities and work plans, including driving strategic initiatives that align the workforce with CASA’s organisational goals. This position supports in the delivery of high-level policy advice, assists to solve complex problems and data analytic solutions including reviewing, interpreting, analysing, and reporting workforce metrics and related commentary for relevant HR reporting requirements.

This includes workforce planning, analysing trends, managing risks, and implementing strategies. The role collaborates with stakeholders and ensuring compliance with legislative and organisational requirements.  This position supports the organisation in exercising and discharging its responsibilities under federal and state employment legislation, the Civil Aviation Act 1988, and associate policies, processes and procedures under those legislative instruments.  This position may be required to work reasonable additional hours beyond the ordinary hours of work, including work on weekends or outside the span of hours. However, this is regarded as the exception and where additional hours are agreed and worked, the employee records those hours within timesheets and in accordance with CASA’s Enterprise Agreement.

Ideal Candidate

This position’s responsibilities include:

  • Developing and maintaining robust data models and dashboards to track key workforce metrics.
  • Ensuring data accuracy, integrity and compliance with privacy regulations by implementing rigorous quality control measures and adhering to data governance standards.
  • Interpreting workforce data to identify trends, patterns and areas for improvement and providing actionable insights to support decision-making at all levels within CASA.
  • Understanding and contextualising CASA’s strategic direction, broad functions, and operating environment to develop, communicate and implement effective, fit for purpose workforce strategies and initiatives.
  • Providing relevant data and written analysis into CASA’s corporate governance reports and statutory reporting obligations such as Board papers, Questions on Notice, Senate Estimates briefs and reporting to the Workplace Gender and Equality Agency (WGEA).
  • Developing reports and analysis on the results of the annual employee census.
  • Maintaining and enhancing the HR analytics and visualisation function for CASA including, cultivating a productive working relationship with system providers.
  • Being informed on best practices and emerging trends in workforce analytics, continuously seeking opportunities to enhance the team’s capabilities and methodologies.
  • Contributing to the development of team objectives including short term tasks and strategic operational planning for longer-term initiatives. Exercising sound judgement and making administrative/operational decisions based on expertise and knowledge, under limited guidance. Making decisions that consider relevant regulations, CASA’s operating procedures, and the application of best practice.
  • Providing expert advice on HR legislative requirements and more complex areas of operational processes and/or policy as needed.
  • Representing CASA on specific issues at internal or external fora. Delivering moderately complex projects and initiatives that involve significant stakeholder engagement and impact business outcomes.
  • Evaluating the effectiveness of risk management and risk assessment activities within sphere of responsibility.
  • Maintaining a positive health and safety culture, including psychosocial wellbeing in the workplace and providing input, where appropriate, into decisions that may impact upon personal health, safety and wellbeing in the workplace.
  • Demonstrating awareness of the diverse histories, cultures, and experiences of First Nations Peoples and other cultural groups. Communicating with respect and understanding of balancing work, family and community responsibilities.
  • Positively engaging in and responding to change. Supporting others through change.
  • Other duties as required.

Experience, skills and capabilities This position requires the following experience, skills, and capabilities:

  • HR and data visualisation/reporting/research experience across a broad range of activities including AI and PowerBi and potentially relating to the work of different program areas
  • The ability to manage various Human Resource Projects. Including the development of project proposals and timelines. Communicate project updates, and implementation plans to the managers and the Senior Executive. Provide Secretariat support for committees as required.
  • Ability to apply technical/specialist knowledge, exercise initiative and use analysis and problem-solving skills to address moderately complex matters. Experience in applying judgement when making decisions within established standards, policies, and procedures.
  • Significant experience in communicating complex information with clarity and influence. Building rapport and using negotiation and persuasion skills to resolve moderately complex issues, and tailoring messages and message delivery to achieve desired outcomes with varied stakeholders.
  • Significant experience in managing relationships with stakeholders to achieve work area goals. Anticipating and responding to stakeholder needs and expectations. Developing and supporting complex relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Well-developed understanding of relevant Australian government legislation, regulations, and policy frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with research and analysis to ensure application of best practice principals when making decisions that involve complex or escalated issues, longer-term planning and liaison with other sections on policy, project or operational issues.
  • Demonstratable abilities in inclusion and collaboration by drawing on diverse perspectives to improve outcomes. Experience working with emotional intelligence to build positive relationships and resolve moderately complex interpersonal issues.

About Our Division The Corporate Service Division contributes to aviation safety by enhancing CASA's capability, capacity and service delivery.  We are responsible for:

  • Human resource functions, including workforce planning
  • Regulatory and technical training and professional development
  • Governance oversight and coordination across the organisation
  • Managing productive working relationships with the Minister’s Office and other government agencies
  • Information technology services
  • Business improvement and change management
  • Portfolio management and service delivery transformation program

You can click here for more information about CASA or to learn more about our people, culture and how to apply for a job at CASA here.

companyProfile.name: Civil Aviation Safety Authority
companyProfile.overview: The Civil Aviation Safety Authority (CASA) was established on 6 July 1995 as an independent statutory authority. Under section 8 of the, Civil Aviation Act 1988, CASA is a body corporate separate from the Commonwealth. CASA's primary function is to conduct the safety regulation of civil air operations in Australia and the operation of Australian aircraft overseas. It is also required to provide comprehensive safety education and training programmes, cooperate with the Australian Transport Safety Bureau, and administer certain features of Part IVA of the Civil Aviation (Carriers' Liability) Act 1959. The Civil Aviation Regulations 1988 and the Civil Aviation Safety Regulations 1998, made under authority of the Civil Aviation Act, provide for general regulatory controls for the safety of air navigation. The Civil Aviation Act and CAR 1988 empower CASA to issue Civil Aviation Orders on detailed matters of regulation. The CASRs 1998 empower CASA to issue Manuals of Standards which support CASR by providing detailed technical material., Source: this is an extract from the company’s own website
